facts.title: Your suitcase
facts.why: You don't have to drag it through a single station. Hand it in at the hotel desk and it's at the next hotel tomorrow.
facts.detail: About 3,000 yen inside Tokyo, about $19, and it's there the next day.
facts.source: japan-guide.com/e/e2278.html (suitcase under 25 kg: 3,000 yen within Greater Tokyo, 3,200 yen Tokyo-Osaka/Kyoto, usually next day, hotel-to-hotel possible); Yamato Transport 'Hands-Free Travel', global-yamato.com/en/hands-free-travel/. Kurs 2026-09-03

facts.title: Your bank card
facts.why: Most Japanese bank ATMs simply don't take a card issued outside Japan.
facts.detail: 7-Eleven has over 28,000 machines and they run all night.
facts.source: Seven Bank, sevenbank.co.jp/intlcard/index2.html (over 28,000 ATMs, card marks accepted); japan-guide.com/e/e2208.html ('A considerable number of ATMs in Japan do not accept credit, debit and ATM cards that are issued outside of Japan')

facts.title: The last train
facts.why: The whole network stops overnight, and the taxi meter goes up while it's stopped.
facts.detail: Taxis add 20 percent from 10pm, and there's no train to fall back on.
facts.source: Tokyo Hire-Taxi Association, taxi-tokyo.or.jp/call/pricelist.html ('22時～5時まで　2割増', Grundpreis 500 Yen bis 1,0 km); JNTO, japan.travel/en/plan/getting-around/taxis/ ('A late-night surcharge is added between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.', 7-km-Fahrt in Tokio 2.500-3.000 Yen tagsueber, Taxis noetig 'after public transportation shuts down'). Kurs 2026-09-03
